#### Fig 4A: Volcano plots {.tabset}

-log10[MW p] (y) vs MW estimate (x) 

```{r baselineVolc_setup}

labSize <- 3
est_cap_value_plot <- 5
label_p_min <- 0.00001
```

label for p < `r paste0(label_p_min)`

```{r baselineVolcanos, fig.height=6, fig.width=9}


df_for_vp <- sig_assay_df %>%
  ### make longer
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!c(rowname, Time, variable), names_to = "stat", values_to = "value", values_transform = as.character) %>%
  ### make names generic
  dplyr::mutate(stat = str_after_first(stat, "__")) %>%
  ### return to wide
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "stat", values_from = "value") %>%
  ## make numeric
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(c(p_raw,p_adj,est,Ngroup2,Ngroup1)), as.numeric) %>%
  ## remove rows without stats (only had one group)
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_raw)) %>%
  ### refactorize dir
  dplyr::mutate(dir = ifelse(grepl("p < 0.1",dir),"not_sig",dir),
                dir = factor(dir,  c("up, p < 0.05","not_sig","down, p < 0.05")),
                ## cap est at 5
                est_cap = ifelse(est > est_cap_value_plot, 
                                 est_cap_value_plot, 
                                 ifelse(est < -est_cap_value_plot, 
                                        -est_cap_value_plot,
                                        est)),
                ### add label only for sig
                label_print = ifelse(p_raw < label_p_min, str_before_last(as.character(variable),"__"), ""))

 color_df <- data.frame("category"=c("up, p < 0.05","not_sig","down, p < 0.05"),
                             "colors"=c( unname(group_colors_to_use[2]),
                                         "grey70",
                                         unname(group_colors_to_use[1])))
  
      colors_to_use <- color_df$colors[which(color_df$category %in% unique(df_for_vp$dir))]

    p <- ggplot(df_for_vp,
                  aes(est_cap,-log10(p_raw),color=dir, fill=dir, label=label_print)) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.65) + 
        theme_bw()  +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0,linetype="dashed",color = "grey60") +
        geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),linetype="dashed",color = "grey60") +

        geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 20, size = labSize, 
                        point.padding = 3,
                        show.legend = FALSE) + #this removes the 'a' from the legend
        #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5,5), breaks = seq(-5,5,1))+
        scale_color_manual(values=colors_to_use)+
        scale_fill_manual(values=colors_to_use)+
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(0,3))+
        ggtitle(paste0(length(which(df_for_vp$dir == "up, p < 0.05"))," up, ",
                       length(which(df_for_vp$dir == "down, p < 0.05"))," down"))+
        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              axis.text = element_text(size = 13)) +
        guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4), title = groups_to_compare$name),fill=guide_legend(title = groups_to_compare$name))#+
       # scale_size(guide = 'none') ### remove the size from legend

      
plot(p)

```

#### Supp Fig 5A: Compare groups {.tabset}

```{r PCA_compareGroups, results='asis', fig.height=4, fig.width=5}


#### for each timepoint of interest
for(curr_time in Time_Point_order){
  
  cat("##### ",paste0(curr_time," {.tabset}"),"\n")
  cat('\n')
  
  for(pca_scale_to_use in c(TRUE,FALSE)){
    
    cat("###### ",paste0("scale = ", pca_scale_to_use," {.tabset}"),"\n")
    cat('\n')
    
    
    ######## for olink, use log10
    
    if(grepl("olink", curr_var_set)){
      
      ## make true long format
      curr_phen_long1 <- curr_phen_long %>%
        ### trim to timepoint
        dplyr::filter(Time_Point == curr_time) %>%
        ### also add useful group
        dplyr::mutate(value = log10(amount)) %>%
        ### rename Group to generic
        dplyr::rename(group=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(group)
      
    }else{
      ## make true long format
      curr_phen_long1 <- curr_phen_long %>%
        ### trim to timepoint
        dplyr::filter(Time_Point == curr_time) %>%
        ### also add useful group
        dplyr::mutate(value = amount) %>%
        ### rename Group to generic
        dplyr::rename(group=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(group)
      
      
    }
    
    
    
    list_of_plotted[[paste0(fig_name_to_use,"_PCA_",curr_time)]] <- curr_phen_long1[,c("Sample_ID","group","variable","amount","value")]
    
    
    ### generate dataframe for PCA, columns are assays, rows are samples
    curr_cm_prep <- curr_phen_long1 %>%
      ### trim to only the olink columns and the animal
      dplyr::select(c(Sample_ID,group,variable,value)) %>%
      ### combine animal and group
      dplyr::mutate(group_animal = paste0(group,"_",Sample_ID),
                    #group = NULL,
                    Sample_ID = NULL) %>%
      ### make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "value") 
    
    
    curr_cm <- curr_cm_prep %>%
      ### remove columns with all NAs for at least one group
      dplyr::select(group, curr_cm_prep %>%
                      group_by(group) %>%
                      dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), ~!all(is.na(.x)))) %>%
                      ungroup() %>%
                      dplyr::select(-group) %>%
                      dplyr::select(where(all)) %>%
                      names()) %>%
      ###remove group
      dplyr::select(-group) %>%
      ### make group_animal rownames
      column_to_rownames("group_animal") %>%
      ### also remove columns (assays) with any NA since prcomp can't handle it and would rather lose an assay than a sample
      dplyr::select(where(function(x) !any(is.na(x))))
    
    
    
    #### factorize curr_meta
    curr_meta <- curr_phen_long1 %>%
      ### select only the metadata
      dplyr::select(c(Sample_ID,group,Group_simp)) %>%
      ### extract ALFQA
      dplyr::mutate(ALFQA = str_after_last(Group_simp,"_"),
                    Group_simp = NULL) %>%
      ### make unique
      unique() %>%
      ### combine animal and group
      dplyr::mutate(group_animal = paste0(group,"_",Sample_ID)) %>%
      ### make group_animal rownames
      column_to_rownames("group_animal") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(group_f = factor(group, group_order))
    
    
    #### print thenumber of animals
    
    cat('\n')
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key! 
    
    
    to_print <-  as.data.frame(table(curr_meta$group)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Group=Var1,Num_animals=Freq) %>%
      DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                    options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                   buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                   iDisplayLength = 25,
                                   lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                     c(10,25,50,"All"))))
    
    #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
    
    
    
    cat('\n')
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key! 
    
    
    ### generate PCA
    pca <- prcomp(curr_cm, scale. = pca_scale_to_use)
    
    ### calculate % for each PC
    pc_pct_list <- list()
    for(i in 1:10){
      pc_pct_list[[paste0("PC",i)]] <- round(pca$sdev[i]^2/sum(pca$sdev^2)*100,2)
    }
    m.pc1 = round(pca$sdev[1]^2/sum(pca$sdev^2)*100,2)
    m.pc2 = round(pca$sdev[2]^2/sum(pca$sdev^2)*100,2)
    m.pc3 = round(pca$sdev[3]^2/sum(pca$sdev^2)*100,2)
    m.pc4 = round(pca$sdev[4]^2/sum(pca$sdev^2)*100,2)
    
    
    ####### only need PC1 vs PC2 as others are not useful
    pcs_pairs <- list(c("PC1","PC2"))
    pca_pairs_list <- list(c(1:2))
    # pcs_pairs <- list(c("PC1","PC2"),c("PC3","PC4"),c("PC5","PC6"),c("PC7","PC8"))
    # pca_pairs_list <- list(c(1:2),c(3:4),c(5:6),c(7:8))
    
    for(pca_pair in 1:length(pcs_pairs)){
      pcs_to_plot <- pcs_pairs[[pca_pair]]
      pca_pairs <- pca_pairs_list[[pca_pair]]
      
      xlab=paste0(pcs_to_plot[1]," (",pc_pct_list[[paste0(pcs_to_plot[1])]]," %)")
      ylab=paste0(pcs_to_plot[2]," (",pc_pct_list[[paste0(pcs_to_plot[2])]]," %)")
      
      # cat("##### ",paste0(pcs_to_plot[1], " vs ", pcs_to_plot[2]),"\n")
      # cat('\n')
      # 
      ### trim to number of loadings you want    
      pca_trim <- pca
      scores <- data.frame(pca_trim$x[, pca_pairs])
      scores[] <- lapply(scores, function(x) x / sqrt(sum((x - mean(x))^2))) 
      loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_trim$rotation)[pca_pairs]
      
      scale <- min(
        max(abs(scores[,pcs_to_plot[1]]))/max(abs(loadings[,pcs_to_plot[1]])),
        max(abs(scores[,pcs_to_plot[2]]))/max(abs(loadings[,pcs_to_plot[2]]))
      )*0.8
      
      ## add labels and positions to loadings_df
      loadings_df <- data.frame(loadings * scale) %>%
        rownames_to_column("var") 
      
      ##trim    
      top_rots <- c()
      for(curr_pc in pcs_to_plot){
        pca_trim_rot <- loadings_df
        ### add sort column
        pca_trim_rot$PC_to_sort <- abs(pca_trim_rot[,curr_pc])
        ### collect top (pos or neg)
        pca_trim_rot <- pca_trim_rot %>%
          arrange(desc(PC_to_sort)) 
        top_rots <- c(top_rots, pca_trim_rot$var[1:num_loadings_per_PC])
      }
      
      ### now trim to only the top loadings
      top_unique <- unique(top_rots)
      loadings_df2 <- loadings_df[loadings_df$var %in% top_unique,]
      
      
      
      ### plot for all paramters:
      
      #### base plot
      p <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = !!rlang::sym(pcs_to_plot[1]), y = !!rlang::sym(pcs_to_plot[2]))) + 
        stat_ellipse(aes(fill = curr_meta$group_f), geom = "polygon", level = as.numeric(ellipse_prob), inherit.aes = TRUE, alpha = 0.4) +
        geom_point(aes(fill=curr_meta$group_f, shape = curr_meta$ALFQA), size = 3, stroke = 0.7)+
        scale_fill_manual(name="Group",values=group_colors_to_use) +  
        scale_shape_manual(name="Adjuvant",values=c(Alum=21,ALFQA=24)) + 
        xlab(xlab)+ylab(ylab)+
        guides(fill=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21)),color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape=21))) + ### change shape in legend to have fillable quality
        
        
        ### add loadings on top for final plot
        geom_segment(data = loadings_df2,
                     aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = !!rlang::sym(pcs_to_plot[1]), yend = !!rlang::sym(pcs_to_plot[2])), 
                     color = "grey40", arrow = arrow(angle = 25, length = unit(4, "mm")))+
        geom_text_repel(data = loadings_df2, aes(x = !!rlang::sym(pcs_to_plot[1]), y = !!rlang::sym(pcs_to_plot[2]), label = var), size=3.5, color="grey25",
                        min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = 'grey60') +
        #coord_fixed() +
        theme_bw()+  
        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank() ,
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
      
      plot(p)
      
      
      cat('\n')
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key! 
      
      ##### also print loadings dff
      
      to_print <- loadings_df %>% 
        dplyr::arrange(desc(PC1)) %>%
        DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                      options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                     buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                     iDisplayLength = 25,
                                     lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                       c(10,25,50,"All"))))
      
      #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
      print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
      
      
      
    }
    
    cat('\n')
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key! 
    
  }
  
  cat('\n')
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key! 
  
  
  
}
```

```{r diffGroupsSummary, results='asis', fig.width=15, fig.height=12}
                                           ifelse(p>0.05,"not_sig","no_test"))),

                                    ifelse(grepl("__Baseline",Comp),

                                                  3,
                                                  ifelse(grepl("FC",Comp),

  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Comp", values_from = "dir") %>%

  data.frame()

  "by Assay, dir"=c("var_name",dir_columns),
  "by dir, Assay"=c(dir_columns,"var_name")
)



timepoints_df <- data.frame("tp"=c("Baseline","wk12_24or72h","wk13","wk13_14","wk14","wk14_15","wk17","Post"),
                            "color"=c("grey95",
                                      "lemonchiffon",
                                      "lemonchiffon3",
                                      "bisque1",
                                      "bisque2",
                                      "bisque2",
                                      "bisque3",
                                      "bisque4")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("tp")



time_for_anncolors <- timepoints_df[tps_for_thisSet,]
names(time_for_anncolors) <- tps_for_thisSet


####


annotation_colors=list()
annotation_colors[["Group_f"]] <- group_colors_to_use

annotation_colors[["Time_point"]] <- time_for_anncolors
for(curr_dir in dir_columns){
  annotation_colors[[paste0(curr_dir)]] <- c("up, p < 0.05"="red2","up, p < 0.1"="lightpink",not_sig="black",
                                             "down, p < 0.1"="skyblue","down, p < 0.05"="blue2",no_test="white")
}


# 
# cat("#### ", paste0("summary heatmaps {.tabset}"),"\n")
# cat("\n")


for(hmo in names(hm_orders_to_use)){
  
  ### make sorted by dir active
  if(hmo == "by dir, Assay"){
    tag_line <- " {.active}"
  }else{
    tag_line <- " "
  }
  
  cat("#### ", paste0("untrimmed, ",hmo,tag_line),"\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  
  
  ### arrange rows by order to use
  curr_ann_row1 <- dplyr::arrange(annotation_row,  annotation_row[,hm_orders_to_use[[hmo]]]) 
  
  
  
  tmp2 <-  df_to_plot[rownames(curr_ann_row1),intersect(rownames(annotation_col),colnames(df_to_plot))] %>%
    ### remove columns with all NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(.) any(!is.na(.))))
  
  ### set the gaps for the rows from first element of orders, except if assay
  if(hm_orders_to_use[[hmo]][1] != "Assay"){
    gaps_df <- data.frame(table(curr_ann_row1[,hm_orders_to_use[[hmo]][1]])) %>%
      mutate(cumsum = cumsum(Freq))
    if(length(unique(gaps_df$Freq)) ==1){
      if(unique(gaps_df$Freq) == 1){
        gaps_row_to_use <- 0
      }else{
        gaps_row_to_use <- unique(gaps_df$cumsum)
      }
      
    }else{
      gaps_row_to_use <- unique(gaps_df$cumsum)
    }
    
  }else{
    #gaps_df <- data.frame("cumsum"=c(0))
    gaps_row_to_use <- 0
  }
  
  #### gaps for column timepoints
  
  gaps_dfcol_prep <- annotation_col %>%
    ### add group time
    dplyr::mutate(group_time = paste0(Group_f,"__",Time_point),
                  group_time = factor(group_time, unique(group_time)))
  
  gaps_dfcol <- data.frame(table(gaps_dfcol_prep$group_time)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Var1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cumsum = cumsum(Freq))     
  
  
  
  
  ### remove variable so not plotted
  curr_ann_row <- curr_ann_row1%>%
    dplyr::select(-var_name)
  
  # 
  if(grepl("olink",curr_var_set)){
    row_font_size <- 3
  }else{
    row_font_size <- 7
  }
  
  
  
  hc <-
    pheatmap(tmp2,
             scale=row_scale_set, 
             na_col = "grey70",
             cluster_cols=FALSE, 
             cluster_rows = FALSE,
             fontsize_row = row_font_size,
             fontsize_col = 3,
             gaps_col =unique(gaps_dfcol$cumsum),
             gaps_row = gaps_row_to_use,
             col=mycols, breaks=breakscale, 
             clustering_method="ward.D2",
             annotation_col = annotation_col, 
             annotation_row = curr_ann_row,
             annotation_colors = annotation_colors)
  
  hc
  
  
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
}

cat("\n")
cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
```

```{r AssocWithOlink, results='asis', fig.height=12, fig.width=15}



### for each dataset type

for(curr_ds in ds_to_use){
  cat("#### ",paste0(curr_ds," {.tabset}"),"\n")
  cat('\n')
  
  
  Corr_name <- paste0(Corr_name_base,"_",curr_var_set,"_",curr_ds)
  
  ## full_df only has the variables in columns and the factorized group (plus any other covariates if they are in the model)
  
  full_df <- curr_phen_long %>%
    ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
    dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable, !!rlang::sym(curr_ds))) %>%
    ## move comp and timepoint to var
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                  var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                  Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                  variable = NULL) %>%
    ## make wider
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = all_of(curr_ds)) %>%
    ## remove columns with only NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
    ### add in group 
    dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                       dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                       ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                       dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                       dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                       ungroup(), 
                     by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
    ### factorize group
    dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
      names(group_colors_to_use),
      unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
  
  
  
  
  #### collect olink
  full_df_olink <- curr_phen_long_olink %>%
    ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
    dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable, !!rlang::sym(curr_ds))) %>%
    ## move comp and timepoint to var
    dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                  var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                  Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                  variable = NULL) %>%
    ## make wider
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = all_of(curr_ds)) %>%
    ## remove columns with only NA
    dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
    ### add in group 
    dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                       dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                       ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                       dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                       dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                       ungroup(), 
                     by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
    ### factorize group
    dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
      names(group_colors_to_use),
      unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
  
  
  
  
  #### need there to be some variables
  if(dim(full_df)[2] > 1){
    
    ### for each group separately
    ### prep to collect
    corr_df_combo <- data.frame()
    
    for(curr_group in names(group_colors_to_use)){
      
      
      #curr_df1: rows = samples, columns = variables
      #curr_df2: rows = samples, columns = olink
      
      
      curr_df1 <- full_df %>%
        ## filter to only this group
        dplyr::filter(Group_f == curr_group) %>%
        ## filter to only the common animals
        rownames_to_column() %>%
        dplyr::filter(rowname %in% intersect(unique(rowname),rownames(full_df_olink))) %>%
        column_to_rownames() %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(-c(Group_f))
      
      curr_df2 <- full_df_olink %>%
        ## filter to only this group
        dplyr::filter(Group_f == curr_group) %>%
        ## filter to only the common animals
        rownames_to_column() %>%
        dplyr::filter(rowname %in% intersect(unique(rowname),rownames(curr_df1))) %>%
        column_to_rownames() %>%
        ## trim to only the variable columns
        dplyr::select(-c(Group_f))
      
      
      ########## do correlation with psych package since much faster
      sp <- psych::corr.test(as.matrix(signif(curr_df1,7)), as.matrix(signif(curr_df2,7)), method = cor_method,
                             use="pairwise",
                             adjust="none",ci=FALSE)
      
      cor_mat <- sp$r
      cor_test_mat <- data.frame(sp$p)
      
      ## no adj p for multiple comparisons by BH over assays since never symmetric
      # cor_test_adj_mat <- cor_test_mat #duplicate dataframe to replace values
      # for(curr_assay in colnames(curr_df1)) {
      #   cor_test_adj_mat[curr_assay,] <- p.adjust(cor_test_mat[curr_assay,], method = "BH")
      # }
      # 
      #  
      #### also combine to dataframe since only one columns
      corr_df <- dplyr::left_join(data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
                                    ##make longer
                                    tidyr::pivot_longer(!var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "R_value"),
                                  data.frame(cor_test_mat) %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
                                    ##make longer
                                    tidyr::pivot_longer(!var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "raw_p"),
                                  by = c("var1","var2")) %>%
        ### add columns
        dplyr::mutate(
          ### set R_value to NA if p is NA i.e there were only 2 datapoints, some how the R is calculated but the p is not
          R_value = ifelse(is.na(raw_p),NA,R_value),
          
          #### for p < ann_pval_level
          dir = ifelse(R_value > 0 & raw_p < ann_pval_level,
                       "up", 
                       ifelse(R_value < 0 & raw_p < ann_pval_level,
                              "down","not_sig")),
          Group = paste0(curr_group))# %>%
      #### remove self correlations ---> none since comparing to olink
      #  dplyr::filter(var1 != var2)
      
      
      corr_df_combo <- rbind(corr_df_combo, corr_df)
      
    }
    
    # ### if FC or delta, remove baselines
    # if(curr_ds != "amount"){
    #   corr_df_combo <- corr_df_combo %>% 
    #     dplyr::filter(Time != "Baseline")
    # }
    # 
    ### save stats
    list_of_stats[[paste0(Corr_name_base,"_",str_remove_all(curr_var_set,"_columns"),"_",
                          substring(curr_ds,1,2) ## trim to 2 letters since too long for excel tab name
    )]] <- corr_df_combo
    
    # saveRDS(corr_df_combo, file = file.path(outputRData_dir, 
    #                                                               paste0(Corr_name,"_", cor_method,"_CoefPvals_untrimmed.rds")))
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    ################## now plot sig correlations for all groups
    
    
    
    
    cor_test_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,raw_p,Group) %>%
      ## replace NaN with na
      dplyr::mutate(raw_p = ifelse(is.nan(raw_p),NA,raw_p)) %>%
      ##  combine var2 and group
      dplyr::mutate(var2_group = paste0(var2,"__",Group),
                    var2 = NULL,
                    Group = NULL) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var2_group",values_from = "raw_p") %>%
      column_to_rownames("var1") %>%
      ## filter to only vars that are sig in at least one group
      dplyr::filter_at(vars(everything(.)), any_vars(. < ann_pval_level)) %>%
      as.matrix() 
    
    cor_mat_for_plot <- corr_df_combo %>%
      ### trim to only p values
      dplyr::select(var1,var2,R_value,Group) %>%
      ##  combine var2 and group
      dplyr::mutate(var2_group = paste0(var2,"__",Group),
                    var2 = NULL,
                    Group = NULL) %>%
      ## make wider
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var2_group",values_from = "R_value") %>%
      ### filter to only sig vars
      dplyr::filter(var1 %in% rownames(cor_test_mat_for_plot)) %>%
      column_to_rownames("var1") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    cl_ratio <- 0.2
    pch_cex <- .6
    tl_cex <- 0.1
    alluvial_text <- 3
    
    if(length(which(cor_test_mat_for_plot <  as.numeric(ann_pval_level))) == 0){
      
      
      cat(" ",paste0("no variables with p < ",ann_pval_level),"\n")
      cat('\n')
      
      
    }else{
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("corrplot"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      #### otherwise can use the stars
      corrplot::corrplot(cor_mat_for_plot, method = 'square', 
                         is.corr = FALSE, #since not symmetric
                         p.mat = cor_test_mat_for_plot,
                         sig.level = as.numeric(ann_pval_level), 
                         insig='label_sig',  #set p < 0.05 to blank
                         pch.cex = pch_cex, pch.col = 'white',tl.col = 'black',tl.cex=tl_cex,
                         ##legend
                         cl.ratio = cl_ratio, #cl.cex = 2,
                         #addCoef.col ='grey80', 
                         #number.cex = 0.5, #add corr coeff to sig circles
                         #order = order, ## CANNOT ORDER ASSYMMETRIC
                         col = (COL2('PuOr',1000)), ##make orange NEGATIVE
                         col.lim = c(-1,1) ##set limits to be the same across plots
                         # title = vaccine_groups[i], mar=c(0,0,1,0) # http://stackoverflow.com/a/14754408/54964
      )
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      ########## add alluvials
      
      
      
      df_for_alluvials <- corr_df_combo %>%
        ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
        dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                      ### add dir
                      dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                                   ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                                   "not_sig")) %>%
        
        
        
        dplyr::select(-c(var1,var2,raw_p,R_value))  %>%
        
        ### remove notsig for all groups
        ## make wider
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = "dir") %>%
        column_to_rownames("variable") %>%
        ## remove rows if all not_sig 
        dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(. != "not_sig")) %>%
        ## also remove if all na
        dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(!is.na(.))) %>%
        ### back to long
        rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !variable, names_to = "Group", values_to = "dir") %>%
        ## factorize
        dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, names(group_colors_to_use)),
                      dir = factor(dir, c("pos","not_sig","neg")),
                      variable = factor(variable)) %>%
        ## arrange
        dplyr::arrange(dir, variable, Group)
      
      
      color_df <- data.frame("group"=unique(levels(df_for_alluvials$dir)),
                             "color"=c("purple","grey","orange"),
                             "outline"=c("black","black","black"))
      
      curr_color_df <- color_df[which(color_df$group %in% unique(df_for_alluvials$dir)),]
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("alluvial"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      gg <- ggplot(df_for_alluvials,
                   aes(x = Group, stratum = dir, alluvium = variable))+
        stat_alluvium(aes(fill = dir), width = 1/2, alpha = 1/2,) +
        stat_stratum(aes(stratum = dir, fill = dir), width = 1/2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = curr_color_df$color)+
        stat_alluvium(geom = "text", aes(label = variable), size = alluvial_text, show.legend = FALSE) + ## to label NA category
        stat_alluvium(geom = "text", aes(label = variable, color = dir), size = alluvial_text, show.legend = FALSE) +
        
        scale_color_manual(values = curr_color_df$outline)+
        theme_bw()+
        labs(fill = paste0(cor_method," p < ", ann_pval_level, " R direction"))
      
      plot(gg)
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
      cat("##### ",paste0("table"),"\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      
      to_print <- corr_df_combo %>%
        ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
        dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                      var1_time = str_after_last(var1,"__"),
                      var1 = str_before_last(var1,"__"),
                      var2_time = str_after_last(var2,"__"),
                      var2 = str_before_last(var2,"__"),
                      
                      ### add dir
                      dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                                   ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                                   "not_sig")) %>%
        #### trim to variables in alluvial
        dplyr::filter(variable %in% df_for_alluvials$variable) %>%
        dplyr::select(-variable) %>%
        ## make wider to put the groups on the same line
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = c("raw_p","R_value","dir")) %>%
        DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                      options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                     buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                     iDisplayLength = 25,
                                     lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                       c(10,25,50,"All"))))
      
      #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
      print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
      
      cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
      
      
    }
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
  }else{
    cat(" ",paste0("no variables with same animals"),"\n")
    cat('\n')
    
    
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
}
```

### (prep for Figure 8 / Supp Figure 9) Association with ADCC/Eff {.tabset}

```{r vsADCCEff_prep___Fig5}
cor_method <- "spearman"
Corr_name_base <- "VsADCCEff"

#### for corrplots
ann_pval_level <- 0.05
cl_ratio <- 0.7
pch_cex <- 2
tl_cex <- 1

###### for scatterplot
num_columns_for_plot <- 3


### trim to only the variables for this fig
curr_phen_long <- phen_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% c(list_of_vars[[paste0(curr_var_sets[1])]],list_of_vars[[paste0(curr_var_sets[2])]],list_of_vars[[paste0(curr_var_sets[3])]])) %>%
  ### remove naive animals
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))


levels_vars_to_use <- c("Pct_CD14_efferocytes","Arif_ADCC_NCI05specific")
deltaFC_vars_to_use <- c("Pct_CD14_efferocytes","engulfing_capabiluity_MFI_CFSE")


#### collect ADCC & Eff to compare to
full_df_compare <- phen_long %>%
  ### first collect levels vars
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% levels_vars_to_use) %>%
  ### remove naive animals
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))  %>%
  ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
  dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable,amount)) %>%
  ## move comp and timepoint to var
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__")),
                Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                variable = NULL) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(var_comp_time) %>%
  ## make wider
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = "amount") %>%
  ## remove columns with only NA
  dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))) %>%
  
  #### add in FC for FC vars
  dplyr::full_join(phen_long %>%
                     ### first collect levels vars & remove baseline
                     dplyr::filter(variable %in% deltaFC_vars_to_use & Time_Point != "Baseline") %>%
                     
                     ### remove naive animals
                     dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))  %>%
                     ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
                     dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable,FC)) %>%
                     ## move comp and timepoint to var
                     dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                                   var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),"vsBaslineFC"),
                                   Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                                   variable = NULL) %>%
                     ## make wider
                     tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = "FC") %>%
                     ## remove columns with only NA
                     dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))),
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  
  
  #### add in delta for delta vars
  dplyr::full_join(phen_long %>%
                     ### first collect levels vars & remove baseline
                     dplyr::filter(variable %in% deltaFC_vars_to_use & Time_Point != "Baseline") %>%
                     ### remove naive animals
                     dplyr::filter(!grepl("Naive",Group))  %>%
                     ## trim to only Animal_comp_time, var and curr_ds
                     dplyr::select(c(Animal_comp_time,variable,delta)) %>%
                     ## move comp and timepoint to var
                     dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = str_before_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),
                                   var_comp_time = paste0(variable,"__",str_after_first(Animal_comp_time,"__"),"vsBaslineDelta"),
                                   Animal_comp_time = NULL,
                                   variable = NULL) %>%
                     ## make wider
                     tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time", values_from = "delta") %>%
                     ## remove columns with only NA
                     dplyr::select(where(function(x) !all(is.na(x)))),
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  
  
  ### add in group 
  dplyr::left_join(data.frame(unique(phen_long[,c("Sample_ID",group_var_to_use)])) %>%
                     dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID)) %>%
                     ### collapse rows and take first value ***need to see if this is correct**
                     dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use), Sample_ID) %>%
                     dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.))) %>% 
                     ungroup(), 
                   by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Group_to_use=!!rlang::sym(group_var_to_use)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>%
  ### factorize group
  dplyr::mutate(Group_f = factor(Group_to_use, intersect(
    names(group_colors_to_use),
    unique(data.frame(curr_phen_long)[,group_var_to_use])))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Group_to_use)
```

```{r vsTOAsummary}
TOA_tabs <- names(list_of_stats)[grepl("TOA",names(list_of_stats))]
TOA_tabs <- TOA_tabs[!grepl("Baseline",TOA_tabs)] ### remove since redundant
TOA_tabs <- TOA_tabs[!grepl("VsSelf",TOA_tabs)] ### remove since redundant

vsTOA_df <- data.frame()
for(curr_tab in TOA_tabs){
  
  curr_df <- list_of_stats[[paste0(curr_tab)]] %>%
    ### trim to sig
    dplyr::filter(raw_p < 0.05) %>%
    ### add tab name as overall group
    dplyr::mutate(figure = paste0(curr_tab),
                  ## also add am/fc/de to rowname
                  ds = str_after_last(curr_tab,"_"),
                  ds = str_replace_all(str_replace_all(ds,"am","amount"),"de","delta"),
                  var_comp_time_ds = paste0(rowname,"___",ds))
  
  ### add to data.frame
  vsTOA_df <- rbind(vsTOA_df, curr_df)
  
}

#### collect data: columns are assay (var_comp_time_ds_group), rows are animals (all per both groups)
data_for_comp <- phen_long %>%
  ### trim to only columns need
  dplyr::select(studyLetterForMS,Group_ignoreALFQA,Sample_ID,Time_Point,Specimen,variable,TOA_adj,amount,FC,delta) %>%
  ### make longer by amount/FC/delta
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("amount","FC","delta"), names_to = "ds", values_to = "value") %>%
  ### add var_comp_time to match vsTOA_df rowname
  dplyr::mutate(var_comp_time_ds = paste0(variable, "__", Specimen, "__", Time_Point,"___",ds)) %>%
  ### trim to only vsTOA_df rowname
  dplyr::filter(var_comp_time_ds %in% unique(vsTOA_df$var_comp_time_ds)) %>%
  ## now make wider
  dplyr::select(-c(variable,Specimen,Time_Point,ds)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "var_comp_time_ds", values_from = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_ID = paste0("m",Sample_ID))
```

### Summary Tables, p < `r paste0(ann_pval_level)` for at least one group {.tabset}

```{r TOAvars_extraTables, results='asis'}

#### regenerate df_for_alluvials with this cut
df_for_alluvials <- corr_df_combo %>%
  
  ## simplify variable by combining var1 and varw
  dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(pmax(var1, var2),"__vs__",pmin(var1, var2)),
                ### add dir
                dir = ifelse(raw_p < ann_pval_level, 
                             ifelse(R_value > 0, "pos","neg"),
                             "not_sig")) %>%
  
  ### also remove inverse duplicates
  dplyr::select(-c(var1,var2))  %>%
  unique() %>%
  
  
  dplyr::select(-c(raw_p,R_value))  %>%
  
  ### remove notsig for all groups
  ## make wider
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Group", values_from = "dir") %>%
  column_to_rownames("variable") %>%
  ## remove rows if all not_sig 
  dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(. != "not_sig")) %>%
  ## also remove if all na
  dplyr::filter_all(any_vars(!is.na(.))) %>%
  ### back to long
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = !variable, names_to = "Group", values_to = "dir") %>%
  ## factorize
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, names(group_colors_to_use)),
                dir = factor(dir, c("pos","not_sig","neg")),
                variable = factor(variable)) %>%
  ## arrange
  dplyr::arrange(dir, variable, Group) %>%
  #### add back in the p & R
  dplyr::left_join(corr_df_combo[,c("var1","var2","R_value","raw_p","Group")] %>%
                     dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0(var1,"__vs__",var2),
                                   var1=NULL,
                                   var2=NULL),
                   by = c("variable","Group"))

##### for each group
for(curr_group in unique(df_for_alluvials$Group)){
  
  cat("#### ",paste0(curr_group, " {.tabset}"),"\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  
  ##### for each dir
  for(curr_dir in c("pos","neg")){
    
    cat("##### ",paste0(curr_dir, " {.tabset}"),"\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    
    ##### trim to only vars NOT from the same compartment
    
    curr_df_for_alluvials <- df_for_alluvials %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(Plasma_both = ifelse(grepl("Plasma",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) &
                                           grepl("Plasma",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")), 
                                         "both",
                                         "not"), 
                    ADCC_olink_both = ifelse(Plasma_both == "both",
                                             ifelse(grepl("ADCC",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) &
                                                      grepl("ADCC",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")),
                                                    "both",
                                                    ifelse(!grepl("ADCC",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) &
                                                             !grepl("ADCC",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")),
                                                           "both",
                                                           "not")),
                                             "not"),
                    PBMC_both = ifelse(grepl("PBMC",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) & grepl("PBMC",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")), "both","not"), 
                    RM_both = ifelse(grepl("Rect_Muc",str_before_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")) & grepl("Rect_Muc",str_after_first(as.character(variable),"__vs__")), "both","not")) 
    
    
    ###### only between different assay types
    cat("###### ",paste0(" Different Assaytype "),"\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    
    
    to_print1 <- curr_df_for_alluvials %>% 
      dplyr::filter(ADCC_olink_both == "not" & PBMC_both == "not" & RM_both == "not") %>% 
      #### now trim to group & dir
      dplyr::filter(as.character(Group) == curr_group & as.character(dir) == curr_dir) 
    
    
    to_print <- to_print1 %>%
      DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                    options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                   buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                   iDisplayLength = 25,
                                   lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                     c(10,25,50,"All"))))
    
    
    to_print
    #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
    
    
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
    
    
    ##### among same assay types
    cat("###### ",paste0(" Same Assaytype "),"\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    
    
    to_print2 <- curr_df_for_alluvials %>% 
      dplyr::filter(!variable %in% to_print1$variable) %>% 
      #### now trim to group & dir
      dplyr::filter(as.character(Group) == curr_group & as.character(dir) == curr_dir) 
    
    
    to_print <- to_print2 %>%
      DT::datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
                    options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                   buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                                   iDisplayLength = 25,
                                   lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                     c(10,25,50,"All"))))
    
    
    to_print
    #) , height = "100%", width = "100%")
    print(htmltools::tagList(to_print))
    
    
    
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
    
    
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
  
  
  
  
}

cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!

```
